preconditions.description: this whole liquidity grab strategy works best if you're finding reversals at the bottoms or tops of big moves if you're trying to find liquidity grabs in the middle of moves while the chart is going up or down like this it doesn't work so good

entry_sequence.action: a liquidity grab is simply when price breaks a support or resistance and does a fake out and heads in the opposite direction
it can be either sell-side liquidity or buy side liquidity whichever you prefer to trade
you were going to mark your entry point at the candle that made the liquidity grab
your short entry would be at the bottom of this candle that initiated this liquidity grab
we wait for the entry signal once we get it we enter
set show reversals to Tru and just like that it'll find all the liquidity grabs and entries for you

confluences.description: if the liquidity grab and the entry candle were closer than 10 candles apart the drop was a lot larger compared to the Peaks further apart so the back test results are saying Peaks like this had a more impulsive drop than Peaks like this so that's very interesting to note so if you want optimal entries you should look for liquidity grabs with Peaks closer together

to do this simply go to metatrader click insert then indicators scroll down to oscillate and click momentum so here you can see the indicator gave us a long Buy Signal but something else to notice is that here the chart did a liquidity grab so it's making lower lows but if we look at the momentum oscillator it's making higher highs so this is a Divergence and is also a very bullish signal so we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability of working in our favor

we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame so we know there's a strong demand here on the higher time frame and on top of that we have a liquidity grab on a lower time frame which is a great Confluence we move back to the 15-minute time frame and do our normal stop loss and take profit ... we would not enter on this trade because the move is happening in the middle of this range on a higher time frame

stop.description: set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab (for longs); set our stop loss right above the liquidity grab (for shorts)

targets.description: set your take profit at a recent high (for longs); set her take profit at a recent low (for shorts)

instrument_classification.asset_classes: it works for everything stocks Forex crypto it doesn't matter
instrument_classification.timeframes: it works on all time frames

coaching_notes: now of course this strategy isn't absolutely perfect and there are going to be times when it doesn't work
so sure we lost this trade but if we compare it to all of our winners with these huge massive wins this loss is really just a pebble that's what makes the strategy so profitable
